card.name: Words just before a drug amount
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, with, to) and partway-through drug name pieces (dil-ute, lev-ole, es-lic) in dosing text, right before a quantity or the rest of a drug name.

modes.label: Linking word before a quantity
modes.description: A word like of, with or to that sits right before a measured amount or product unit.
